name: Yeo ChaeEon
headline: Robot Learning · Reinforcement Learning · Computer Vision
tagline: Teaching robots to grasp the real world — from simulation to reality.
taglineKo: 시뮬레이션에서 배운 로봇이 현실에서도 잘 잡도록 연구합니다.

education.degree: B.S. Candidate, Computer Science and Engineering

interests: Vision-based Robot Control and Imitation Learning

experience.org: Digital Twin & Physical AI Lab (DTPLAB), Pusan National University
points: Developed RL-based pick-and-place policies for a DofBot manipulator in NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab — real-to-sim joint calibration, actuator tuning, PPO/SAC training, and ROS-based deployment to the physical robot.
Investigated the Sim2Real gap during physical deployment; explored domain randomization and parameter tuning for more robust control.
Built a MuJoCo environment for the LeRobot SO-101 with an inverse-kinematics scripted teacher for multi-object pick-and-place.
Collected ~200 successful demonstrations and trained ACT, Diffusion Policy, and SmolVLA; analyzed failures such as grasp misalignment, slips, and drops.
Built HIL/DAgger-style recovery-data collection and fine-tuning pipelines to cover failure states missing from the original demos.

Designed residual RL in MuJoCo: a pretrained ACT policy as base controller plus an RL policy learning bounded corrections (a_t = a_t^base + Δa_t^RL), with staged dense rewards and geometry-based target inference.

experience.org: Data Creator Camp — Ministry of Science and ICT / NIA
points: Built deep-learning pipelines to identify air-pollution emission sources from satellite imagery (detection, keypoints, regression, segmentation).
YOLO-based chimney detection for source localization, evaluated with mAP@IoU=0.5.
Chimney height estimation combining YOLO detections + keypoints with a ResNet50 regressor (ROI Align + global features) — validation RMSE 8.8 m.
Multispectral industrial-complex segmentation (RGB, NIR, NDVI, NDWI) with a ResNet50 U-Net++.
